source: HEAD export, maps-site/data/*.json|geojson vs maps-site/tiles/5 (Modern) mosaic; static, no browser
key_distinction: REGISTRATION vs RENDERING MEDIUM. Every feature here is already vector (L.polyline / L.polygon on raw atlas-px vertices, roads/lanes/route via crSpline). The offsets below are source-registration errors of the traced vertices; the spline adds at most a few px. Vector geometry mis-registered at the source misaligns exactly as a raster would, and the error scales with zoom like any overlay: screen px = atlas px x 2^(z-4).

method.mosaic: z5 tiles 35x18 pasted to 8960x4608 px; atlas px = z5 px / 2 (no y flip, NZ=4).
method.printed_road_ink: dots = ink (luminance<110) 8-connected components with bbox 4-11 z5 px, fill>0.55, aspect<=1.6, chained to another dot within 8 atlas px (16 z5 px). 2351 chained dots. Self-check vs banked filigree counts: band W 99 (banked ~97, q05), M 49 (banked ~49, q06), E 55 (banked 57, q07). Named-way band-W euclid median 27.9 px reproduces q05 exactly.
method.road_offset: samples every 1 atlas px along raw vertices and along crSpline output (ported verbatim: centripetal CR, seg 16 for buildNamedWays/buildSeaLanes, 18 per leg for buildRoute; clampToFrame is a no-op for every shipped point, all in frame). normal_band = min |normal offset| of dots with |tangent offset|<=4 px within +-100 px; no_dot_in_band_fraction reported separately, never folded into the median. euclid_nearest_dot = plain nearest dot (uncensored). Both are lower bounds: the nearest dot may belong to a different printed road.
method.water_mask: buildCityMask colour test (lum>=110 and r-b<=54, box blur r2, ratio>=0.5). Valid in Leponnia/Great Chasmous Sea; NOT valid under Alensic/Umbadic/Eastern Patrin/Pheropic tints or Emphēros grey-green land (see side_check).
method.realm_borders: print draws realms only as colour washes (legend swatches sampled at legend centre); per-realm nearest-colour classifier (own swatch, overlapping realms swatches, land 195,174,125, sea 175,166,129) on blurred non-ink RGB (r=4 z5 px, Regimen r=7), opened, small parts/holes removed; offset = distance from ring sample to the wash edge.
method.minor_borders: the print has NO district boundary class (regions are spaced lettering only, verified on crop of Leponnia); offset reported to nearest long thin ink (river/coast/graticule) and to the coast of the sea mask, labelled as such, not as registration.
method.sea_lanes: land samples on the water mask beyond 1.35 x footR + endpoint-to-anchor distance at each port; longest land run, total land length, coast-ink crossings.
method.screen_px: atlas px x 2^(z-4): x4 at z6, x9.85 at z7.3; cityMaxZ = min(11.5, 4+log2(max(w,h)/(2 footR))): procedural (GEN_SIZE 2048) capital 9.30, town 10.19, village 10.83, ruin 11.0; Epēshu overlay 3072 -> 9.88; Summarch has no city-anchors entry, so no cityMaxZ. NOTE pWay/pLane/pRouteLine/pRealm/pDistrict are opacity 0 under .map-tier-d (Z_TIER_D 7.5), so at cityMaxZ the line is not drawn; the cityMaxZ figure is the misplacement inherited by gates/quays via APPR_POLYS (raw pts), not a visible line.
method.appr: buildApprPolys + segCircleHits + mergeAngles ported (2.5 x footR circle, 0.25 rad merge). printed_road_bearings = mergeAngles of dots in the annulus [R-4, R+4]. Bearings are screen angles atan2(dy,dx): 0=E, 90=S, 180=W, 270=N.

summarch_coordinates.note: one city, three source coordinates 20-31 px apart inside the shipped data; city-anchors.json has no Summarch entry, so overlay-Summarch registered by registerCityOverlay has no world anchor

cross_ref: Anchor offsets vs printed rings (e.g. Harney anchor 522,195 vs marker/ring 508,207 = 18 px; Stony Ford 591,183 vs 612,172 = 23 px) belong to out/anchor-correction-table.json, not repeated here.

side_check_buildCityMask.scope: outside the polyline brief; bears on registration; sampleCityMask/buildCityMask are hash-pinned by the mobile track: flag only
side_check_buildCityMask.finding: The r-b<=54 water test fires on realm tints and Emphēros grey-green land: 70 of 115 inland anchors with no sea entry read >50% border-connected water (median by realm polygon: Eastern Patrin 0.999 n9, Umbadic 0.99 n3, Alensic 0.862 n8, Pheropic 0.569 n2; untinted Leponnia/Rubea ~0). Impact today is limited: genCityCanvas only uses the mask coast when drawWater (sv non-null: harbor or sea.side with distPx<=25); 16 anchors qualify and none of them exceeds 0.8. For the others the mask feeds only the land hue (LT/GREEN surround and wash re-tone). Latent trap for any registration step that trusts mask.water inland.
